items: 1-command deterministic verification gate (typecheck + unit tests + dist audit)

en.previewSnippet:
# AGENTS.md — Repository Harness

## 1. Fast Verification Gate (Run Before Every Commit)
- Typecheck & lint: `npm run check`
- Targeted unit test: `npx vitest run src/path/to/file.test.ts`
- Full build & link gate: `npm run build`

## 2. Architecture Boundaries
- Single source of truth lives in `content/*.json`; never hardcode copy in UI components.
- Keep context lean: prefer `rg` over dumping full files; delegate broad exploration to read-only subagents.

## 3. Non-Negotiable Constraints
- Preserve public route parity (`/en/*` and `/zh/*`).
- Never commit secrets, `.env` files, or unverified third-party URLs.

zh.previewSnippet:
# AGENTS.md — 仓库智能体工程约束

## 1. 确定性自检门禁（每次提交前必跑）
- 类型与语法检查：`npm run check`
- 单文件极速测试：`npx vitest run src/xxx.test.ts`
- 全量静态构建守门：`npm run build`

## 2. 架构事实源与上下文纪律
- 所有结构化数据唯一存放在 `content/*.json`，严禁在视图组件内硬编码业务文案。
- 保持上下文干净：优先用 `rg` 精准定位行号，宽泛调研交由只读子智能体隔离执行。

## 3. 合规红线
- 严格保持 `/zh/*` 与 `/en/*` 双语路由 100% 对称。
- 严禁写入任何密钥或未经校验的外部死链。

items: Trigger-sharp YAML `description` so the agent activates only when relevant

On-demand `references/` schemas loaded only for edge cases

name: release-audit
description: Verify static build output, broken links, JSON-LD schemas, and bilingual route symmetry before opening a PR. Use whenever shipping UI or content changes.
---
# Release Audit Skill

## Workflow
1. Run `node scripts/validate-content.mjs` and fix any schema or timestamp errors.
2. Execute `npm --prefix web run build`.
3. Inspect only failing routes reported by `scripts/verify-dist.mjs`; never dump full HTML into context.
4. Capture light/dark + mobile 390px screenshots before summarizing results.

zh.title: 渐进式 SKILL.md 智能体技能包骨架
zh.summary: 采用「YAML 摘要路由 → 主流程手册 → 确定性脚本资源」三级按需披露结构，在挂载数十项能力时节省 90% 以上闲置上下文。
items: 高区分度触发条件描述（`description` 写清何时激活、何时不激活）
把易错计算与校验下沉到 `scripts/` 确定性脚本，只向上下文返回精简结论
长篇边缘规范拆分至 `references/`，仅在命中特定分支时按需读取

# 发布前全链路验收技能（Release Audit）

## 标准执行步骤
1. 运行 `node scripts/validate-content.mjs` 确认零越界时间戳与分类错误。
2. 运行 `npm --prefix web run build` 完成类型检查与死链门禁。
3. 仅读取报错摘要定位问题文件，禁止把整份构建 HTML 塞入上下文窗口。
4. 对桌面端深浅色与手机 `390px` 视口做实机渲染巡检后输出简报。

en.title: Trace Error-Analysis & Binary LLM Judge Kit
en.summary: Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar style eval loop: 100 real traces, axial failure taxonomy, and binary PASS/FAIL judge prompt with critique-first JSON.
items: Spreadsheet schema for open coding -> axial failure mode clustering
Binary `PASS` / `FAIL` judge prompt (never vague 1–5 Likert scales)
Train/dev human-judge agreement check (>90% TPR/TNR target)

zh.title: 真实链路坏例归因与二元 LLM 裁判套件
zh.summary: 告别无效的 1–5 分主观打分：用 100 条真实业务 Trace 归纳失败模式，并为每个高频坏例配备高一致性的 PASS/FAIL 专用裁判。
items: 开放式坏例标注表结构（从原始报错归纳 4–6 类高频根因）
强制先写证据推理再给 `PASS / FAIL` 二元结论的裁判 JSON Schema
人工金标集与裁判模型的一致率校准清单（对齐率 >90%）

en.title: Contextual Hybrid RAG + Agentic Search Blueprint
en.summary: Contextualized chunk headers + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (BM25 + dense embeddings) + cross-encoder rerank + iterative query rewrite.
items: Prepend 50-token document/section context header before indexing chunks
Fuse exact BM25 lexical hits with dense cosine recall via RRF (`k=60`)
Expose `search_docs` + `read_section` tools so the agent can refine queries

zh.title: 上下文增强混合检索（Hybrid & Agentic RAG）蓝图
zh.summary: 结合 Anthropic Contextual Retrieval 切块前缀、BM25+向量倒数秩融合（RRF）、重排精筛与智能体多轮改写追问。
items: 切块入库前自动注入 50 字文档全局背景头，消除指代不明丢召回
用 RRF（`k=60`）融合 BM25 精确专有名词匹配与稠密向量语义召回
将检索封装为可多轮调用的工具，允许模型在首轮证据不足时改写词条深挖
